title: ReAct Tool Loop
hints: Keep one growing `messages` list and send the whole list on every call.
Append the assistant turn (with its tool_calls) before any tool results. Providers reject a tool result whose call they never saw.
Run every tool call in the response, in order, and echo each call's own id in its tool message.
Count model calls, not tool calls. The response to call number max_steps is the last one you act on.
